name: Hôtel d'Angleterre Geneva
positioning: Hotel d'Angleterre, an 1872 heritage-listed hotel on the edge of Lake Leman in Geneva, facing the Jet d'Eau and Mont Blanc
best_for: Travelers who want a lakeside Geneva base with views of the Jet d'Eau and Mont Blanc
Food and drink lovers drawn to afternoon tea, a deep wine cellar and a whisky bar with live jazz
Guests who want hands-on local experiences such as a chef-led market tour or a watchmaking workshop

facts.text: The hotel sits at the edge of Lake Leman, with views of the Jet d'Eau and Mont Blanc.
The hotel's address is Quai du Mont-Blanc 17, Geneva.
A short boat ride connects the hotel to the city centre, with the Flower Clock, the Old Town and the Patek Philippe Museum.
In 1960 the hotel was acknowledged as one of the heritage sites of the city of Geneva.
Rooms and suites are individually styled, with art, elegant furnishings and marble-lined bathrooms.
Rooms have Savoir beds with Swiss quality Elite mattresses and evening turndown.
Executive Chef Alexandre Cardiga leads the hotel's culinary offering.
The cellar holds over 225 bins, with a wine list created by Master Sommelier Julien Meurillon.
The traditional afternoon tea includes scones with Gruyeres double cream and homemade jam.
The Leopard Bar offers creative cocktails and live jazz sessions from local bands.
The Leopard Bar drinks menu features over 50 whiskies.
The Leopard Bar serves fresh sushi and light bites.

highlights.text: Guests can join Executive Chef Alexandre Cardiga at the Geneva Market to select ingredients.
A make-your-own-watch experience takes place at the Initium Workshop in Geneva.
The Cigar Lounge in the Leopard Bar has an air-flow extraction system in the floor and the ceiling's wooden panelling.
The hotel was built in 1872 with a facade designed by architect Anthony Krafft.
Le 17 Restaurant has panoramic views across Lake Leman towards Mont Blanc, with cooking shaped by fire and seasonality.

considerations.text: The private Tea on Lake Geneva boat cruise is available from June to September.
The lake fishing experience runs from May to September, depending on weather.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning and prime location.
